INSTAGRAM
AI agents work on my app while I sleep. How my overnight swarm works, and why a human still approves every change.

Every night ~24 Claude Code sub-agents pick up Linear tickets in two waves (research, then implement) and leave one draft PR on a fresh branch. Discord pings me with my coffee. Nothing merges without me.
Tools: Claude Code (claude.com/claude-code) · Linear (linear.app) · Vercel (vercel.com) · PostHog (posthog.com) · Discord (discord.com), all connected through MCP.
Comment SWARM and I'll break down how it is wired up.
